about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a growing wellness group operating several brands across the slimming, aesthetics, spa and wellness sectors, for an ambitious and commercially driven Sales Director based in St. Julian's.

You will take ownership of the group's overall sales performance, leading both remote and on-site sales teams. You will set targets, build sales processes, scripts and training programmes, coach the team, and work with Marketing and Operations to improve lead quality, appointment rates and conversion across every brand, from first enquiry to customer retention.

This is a hands-on, full-time leadership position for a sales professional who can build high-performing teams and drive revenue growth across multiple business units. The salary is €40,000–€50,000 per year.
responsibilities: Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue targets across the group's brands and departments
Set individual, team and departmental sales targets, monitor performance and implement improvements
Recruit, onboard, train and manage sales representatives, booking agents, consultants and customer-facing teams
Build and develop both remote and on-site sales teams with clear performance expectations and accountability
Design and deliver sales training programmes, scripts and guidelines, including objection-handling techniques
Monitor sales calls, customer interactions, CRM activity and follow-up processes to find areas for improvement
Provide regular coaching, feedback and performance reviews
Optimise the customer journey from enquiry and lead generation through booking, conversion and retention
Work with Marketing and Operations to improve lead quality, response times, appointment rates and sales performance
Implement and improve sales workflows, CRM systems, automation and reporting tools
Monitor KPIs including revenue, conversion rates, appointment attendance, average order value and sales productivity
Prepare sales forecasts, performance reports and action plans for management
Identify operational and sales challenges and introduce practical solutions to improve efficiency and profitability
Develop a performance-driven culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement and results
